title: Recurrent cancer hotspots pack (gated source, hg38+hg19)
context: Recurrent cancer mutation hotspots (e.g. positions in KRAS, TP53, PIK3CA that are mutated in many tumours) are among the most-asked-about features in cancer-genomics education and research. Several hotspot resources exist (e.g. MSKCC cancer hotspots), but their redistribution terms require per-source verification (Priority-B). This pack is blocked on catalog-014 confirming a hotspot source as APPROVED before any track is built.
objective: Build a recurrent cancer hotspots track pack on hg38 (primary) and hg19 (via liftOver) from a catalog-014-approved hotspot source, emitting all three browser targets with per-feature provenance and both gate artifacts committed.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is a hotspot dataset confirmed APPROVED in catalog-014 (permitsRedistribution: true with cited clause/URL); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed.
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38; hg19 liftOver with chain provenance and unmapped report committed.
All three browser targets emitted (UCSC + JBrowse 2 + IGV) and render-verified; features appear at expected hotspot loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/pack-015.json.
Per-feature provenance records source record IDs, source release, and license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack carries not-medical-advice notice; hosted at a loadable URL; adoption evidence or blocker recorded.
resources: PLAN.md §7 (Cancer hotspots — Priority B, verify terms)
output: output/packs/cancer-hotspots-hg38/ and output/packs/cancer-hotspots-hg19/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/pack-015.json.
